sentence: This project runs research in human-centered computing that designs software and hardware to enhance human capabilities rather than replace human intelligence.
This project designs sensors made of microscale droplets of liquid crystals to detect microbial contaminants in cell culture media.
This project explores how multicellular robots can develop useful behaviors on their own from the interactions of simple parts.
This project tries to find out how synapses form in the developing brains of mice and humans.
This project builds a computer system that learns to understand how people interact with objects in videos of everyday life.
This project studies attacks that inject false data into networked robotic systems and builds countermeasures to defend against them.
This project develops ways to stream volumetric video over the Internet by predicting motion and upsampling content with deep learning.
This project builds a system in which software sends security policies to hardware, which enforces them to stop exploits.
This project stores digital data in DNA nanostructures and reads it back with super-resolution microscopy.
This project builds a machine learning tool that explains its predictions from single-cell RNA sequencing data.
This project builds a system that adjusts one type of sensor to monitor several kinds of damage in bridges.
This project tries to find out whether skilled adult readers can recognize multiple words at once, using vision and reading tests plus brain imaging.
This project builds ways to find faults in deep neural networks by watching how the models behave while they train.
This project builds a set of open-source hardware and software tools that help scientists share and analyze data about how landscapes change.
This project tries to find out which genes cause body size to differ among closely related roundworm species.
This project builds a robot perception system that improves itself by using its own actions to learn about the scene.
This project builds open-access modules on artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, including adversarial machine learning and threat detection.
